title: v11.2 — Setup & Security Hardening
description: Harden secrets, installation, setup readiness, and guided recovery so a clean supported machine can reach a secure usable state without editing source/config files manually.

title: v11.3 — Non-Technical UX
description: Make setup and daily operation understandable to non-technical users through resumable setup, guided recovery, and a simple main menu while preserving advanced CLI compatibility.

title: v12.0 — Production-Ready Release
description: Complete regression coverage, platform/support policy, clean-machine validation, packaging/release checks, and measurable release readiness.

title: v13.0 — AngysGuard Self-Hosted UX & Linux App
description: Establish the AngysGuard identity, truthful platform/support request workflow, guided Linux desktop app, simple self-hosted Bale/Telegram pairing, and provider capability parity.

title: v14.0 — AngysGuard Managed Control
description: Design and deliver the optional AngysGuard managed account/bot service with passwordless device pairing, revocable device credentials, multi-device control, and official Bale/Telegram bots.

title: Future Platform Expansion — Windows & Android
description: Long-horizon cross-platform work: capability adapters, native Windows agent/app, Android companion app, and Android protected-device feasibility research. This is a planning target, not a claim of current support.

title: Architecture Evolution — Modular Monolith
description: Incrementally move AngysGuard/Laptop Guard toward the documented modular-monolith/ports-and-adapters architecture without a flag-day rewrite or security behavior regressions.
